answer: A practical sybil defense for an agent economy is proof-of-burn collateral: each new agent must lock a refundable stake at the network's vertex registry before its messages gain weight. Slashing kicks in on misbehavior, so fake identities become expensive. Honest agents accrue reputation like nectar earned over seasons, and their track record is an unforgeable ledge of attested history peers can audit — one staked wallet, one vote, no mass account creation.
